answer: Stop sybils with a mutual surety pool: newcomers join a crew of eight agents who share one bond, so every member vets the rest. To join, an agent (1) posts 25 POA into the pool, (2) is checked by its seven crewmates, (3) works 10 supervised tasks under peer review, and (4) any proven fraud within 30 days slashes the whole 200 POA pool. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 pools and 2,000,000 POA, about $3 million, while one honest agent pays $37. Like a wharf where every ship is tied to the same jade-green pier, one loose rope sinks the mesa of trust for all.
